title: Jamaican Burger Bites
description: A twist on the classic burger, these bite-sized patties pack a punch of Jamaican flavor. Serve with your favorite toppings for a fun and easy meal.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, Jamaican seasoning, and grated potato. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
3. Divide the mixture into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
4. Flatten each ball into a patty.
5. Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the oven rack.
8. Assemble the bites by placing a cooked patty on each bun.
